restaurantName: Zhu Zai Ji Shi Fu (Jiangnan Avenue)
address: 429 Jiangnan Avenue South, Haizhu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: A hawker-stall-turned-restaurant now with two branches – this casual, bustling three-storey joint is prized for its authentic Cantonese food. The juicy, flavoursome roast goose has been a big hit for the past 20 years. Other specialities include salted pork trotters, Zhu Ji steamed chicken, and blackened barbecued pork. Pastured pork soup with mung bean-stuffed lotus root tastes delicious and delivers interesting textures....
pageTitle: Zhu Zai Ji Shi Fu (Jiangnan Avenue)
